name: Alcoy (Spain)
description: Four red bars on yellow, charged at the centre with a royal crown above two shields, Saint George on horseback on blue and a castle with wings on blue, the great banner of Saint George of Alcoi.
history: The Estendard d'Alcoi or Bandera Gran de Sant Jordi was made official by unanimous vote of the municipal council on 25 November 2005 after twenty years of corporate use; a banner of this kind is recorded from 1509, replacing the royal banner used since 1447, and a new banner showing Saint George on the cloth was inaugurated on 23 April 1582.

features.role: crowned twin shields — Saint George and a winged castle
